heading: LESSON OBJECTIVE
text: Find parallelogram area and missing base or perpendicular height.

heading: CORE IDEA
text: Area is the region inside a shape, measured in square units.

heading: KEY DEFINITIONS
text: Height is the perpendicular distance between opposite parallel sides.

heading: CORE RULE
text: Area equals base times perpendicular height: A=bh.

heading: HOW IT WORKS
text: Choose a base, locate the 90-degree height, multiply, and write square units.

heading: WORKED EXAMPLE 3
text: Base 8, slanted side 10, height 6: area is 8×6=48, not 8×10.
